$comment: Demo profile (setup --demo): points the memory at the model simulator of the compose profile demo and names the three demo models, which are admitted as models running inside the installation (models.t0_aliases), so the model gate lets them through with no external provider allowed. On a fresh database every key here is unset or still equal to its default, so all are written. These six model settings form one group: if an administrator changed any member, all six are kept, preserving the configured connection and model gate. The simulator answers under any model name; to list these names in its GET /models (the gateway's model check) start it with MOCK_MODEL_IDS=demo-llm,demo-embeddings,demo-reranker. The key is not a secret: the simulator accepts any non-empty key. Apply: memory-admin provision apply deploy/compose/provision/demo-models.json
